name: Bademiya
address: Tulloch Road, behind Taj Mahal Hotel, Colaba
notes: The Colaba seekh roll bench. Busiest after 1 AM — expect to stand.

name: Ayub's
address: Rope Walk Lane, Kala Ghoda, Fort
notes: Kala Ghoda institution. Chicken shawarma roll is the order.

name: Sardar Pav Bhaji
address: Tardeo Road, opposite Tardeo AC Market
notes: Extra butter is not optional. Queue moves faster than it looks.

name: Olympia Coffee House
notes: Irani-style, wood panelling, keema pav. Closes right at midnight — check before you set out.

name: Noor Mohammadi Hotel
notes: Chicken sanju baba. Whole area stays up much later through Ramzan.

name: Bharat Excellensea
address: Bharat House, Mumbai Samachar Marg, Fort
notes: Butter garlic crab, late enough to count.

name: Cafe Universal
notes: Old-Bombay bar-café near VT. Last call is well before closing.

name: Gomantak
notes: Malvani thali, no frills, cheap and fast.

name: Lucky Restaurant
notes: The Bandra station landmark. Biryani after midnight, right by the skywalk.

name: Jai Hind Lunch Home
address: Vile Parle East, near the station
notes: Suburban late dinner staple. Gets loud after midnight on weekends.
